mandatory_legal_checks: Suraj Lamp & Industries v State of Haryana — a power of attorney does NOT convey title to immovable property
TP Act 1882 S.54 — immovable property is transferred only by a registered instrument of conveyance
Registration Act 1908 S.33 — a power used to present documents for registration must be authenticated in the prescribed manner
Contract Act 1872 S.202 — 'irrevocable' is effective only where the attorney has an interest in the subject matter
Contract Act 1872 S.208 — revocation does not bind a third party until they know of it
Stamp Act 1899 S.18 — a deed executed abroad must be stamped within three months of receipt in India
Notaries Act 1952 — notarisation; the evidentiary presumption now sits in the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023
